summary: Besides configuration settings, the ansible_shell_type connection variable selects the shell plugin, and ansible_shell_executable should be updated to match.
questions: How do I tell Ansible a host uses csh or fish?
Which variables control the remote shell type?
Do I need to change ansible_shell_executable when changing shell type?

answer_card.title: Selecting a shell plugin per host
answer_card.answer_md: Set `ansible_shell_type` to choose the plugin, and update `ansible_shell_executable` to match.
